translations.english: Not even the slightest breathing creature was seen in Ayodhya, as all beings, even those of lower species, were devoted followers of Rama. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे नवाधिकशततमः सर्गः ।। 109 ।। Thus ends the hundred and ninth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
